assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game-interface border, a single reusable nine-slice panel frame for a dwarven forge fantasy roleplaying app. Create one square image, front-facing orthographic. The frame is four straight rails of dark chiselled basalt stone banded with hammered warm bronze strips held by round rivets; at each of the four corners a heavy square bronze corner plate with an angular geometric knot engraving and one small ember-orange inlaid gem that glows softly. Material depth, visible hammer marks on the bronze, chipped stone edges, soft dimensional highlights: the tactile artistic UI craft of a classic fantasy strategy game, not a flat vector border. Frame aligned square to the canvas, no perspective. Each rail stays narrow, within the outer 12 percent of the image; corner plates may fill the outer 18 percent. Keep the middle stretches of all four rails simple and continuous so they can stretch in a responsive UI. BACKGROUND: the large rectangular central opening (the central 64 percent in each dimension) and the thin space outside the frame must be filled with perfectly flat, uniform pure magenta #FF00FF, with no texture, no shadow, no gradient and no ornaments crossing it, so it can be keyed out to transparency. Frame nearly fills the canvas with a 3 percent magenta outer margin; nothing cropped. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere in the frame itself. Soft neutral top-left light, charcoal stone, warm bronze, restrained ember orange. No words, no letters, no runes that look like writing, no buttons, no icons, no scenery, no watermark.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production seamless material texture for the panels and buttons of a dwarven forge fantasy game UI. A square, edge-to-edge close-up of dark honed basalt stone worked by a mason. Straight-on orthographic surface, no perspective, no objects, no border or frame, no block joints or mortar lines. Rich hand-painted game-art material with fine shallow chisel marks, soft pitting, and a few very faint warm bronze mineral flecks. A tactile crafted surface rather than a photograph. Color and contrast restrained enough to sit beneath readable UI text: medium-dark warm charcoal grey, no bright highlights, no black holes, no large cracks, no glowing lava. Seamless repeating tile in both axes, no vignette, no directional lighting gradient, no letters, no runes, no emblems, no metal fittings, no scenery, no watermark. Output 1024 square.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production wide 3:1 landscape banner artwork for a dwarven forge fantasy game's campaign lobby. Hand-painted premium strategy-game environment art with atmospheric depth. A vast underground forge hall carved from dark basalt: on the right third, a great stone hearth and a monumental anvil on a stepped dais, lit by a channel of molten metal glowing ember orange; massive square pillars with angular geometric carving recede into warm haze; hanging bronze lanterns and chains; a quiet open stone floor on the left third with cool blue-grey shadow and drifting sparks. Warm ember light against cool charcoal stone, restrained glow, rich detailed foreground stonework and bronze, softer layered distance. Composition reads well as a very wide shallow header: the largest shapes on the right third, a calm open left third. Painterly realism, evocative and beautiful. No characters, no creatures, no letters, no runes that look like writing, no labels, no logos, no UI widgets, no rectangular picture frame, no watermark. Entire canvas opaque edge-to-edge scenery.
